narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed around a surface trough on the afternoon and evening. Slow moving thunderstorms led to some instances of flash flooding across central Virginia.
ev: Water was flowing across the road near the intersection of Shelton Drive and Bloomsbury Road. The water lifted a car to the side of the highway.
Road was closed due to flash flooding at the intersection of Glade road and Foggy Bottom Way.
Numerous areas along Kings Highway were closed due to flash flooding near Route 301.
There were multiple reports of streams over roads. Roads were partially washed out, and cars were stranded in water between Passapatanzy and King George.
A foot of water was flowing from Accokeek Creek over Brook Road near Loblolly Lane. One lane of Brooke Road was impassable.
The 1100 Block of Bloomsbury Road was closed due to water flowing over the road.
